summary: Stocks opened mixed: Nasdaq and S&P slightly higher on Nvidia's beat-and-raise relief, Dow slightly lower; Anthropic IPO pricing and FOMC minutes later today. No change 5 min into the session: no level broken, quote pages blocked, prices are premarket estimates.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Up ~3% premarket on a revenue beat, $130B Q4 guide and $150B buyback; over 162.5 extends the relief rally, but Huang/Muddy Waters overhang means a fill under 157.5 fails.

picks.name: Lowe's
picks.reason: Down 2.5-4.7% premarket (~210-214) as the Q3 beat leaned on a 34c tariff refund and EPS guide held, echoing Home Depot's warning; under 209.5 extends, back over 217 fails.

picks.name: Take-Two Interactive
picks.reason: Rebounding ~5% premarket after a 10% two-day drop as GTA VI reviews land strong ahead of Thursday's midnight launch; over 218 targets the gap, under 210 fails toward Tuesday's 203.9 close.

picks.name: Freeport-McMoRan
picks.reason: Off ~2.5% premarket, an S&P laggard as gold cracks below $3,800 and the stock is down ~21% in a month; under 52.8 extends, reclaiming Tuesday's 55.30 close negates.

picks.name: Marvell Technology
picks.reason: Up ~4% premarket in the post-Nvidia AI-infrastructure bid after closing at 148.74 (high 150.95); over 158 runs, under 152 means the gap is fading.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq-100 futures up ~0.4-0.8% off Tuesday's 656.95 close on Nvidia relief, though gains already faded from 1%+; over 665 extends, under 655 (below yesterday's close) fails.
